abstract: The pathological diagnosis of B-cell lymphomas is transitioning from traditional morphologic assessment to a multidimensional model that integrates histomorphology, immunophenotype, and genetic alterations. Establishing a standardized, stepwise clinical diagnostic pathway has become an urgent priority in precision medicine. This article systematically delineates a "four-step" integrated diagnostic pathway​ for B-cell lymphomas: step 1: initial screening and phenotyping, utilizing immunohistochemistry and flow cytometry to determine lineage and establish a preliminary classification; step 2: definitive diagnosis and differential diagnosis, employing gene rearrangement assays and in situ hybridization to verify clonality and identify characteristic genetic abnormalities; step 3: precision diagnostics, applying high-throughput sequencing for molecular subtyping, prognostic stratification, and targeted therapy guidance; and step 4: frontier exploration, leveraging single-cell and spatial multi-omics technologies along with artificial intelligence to address complex diagnostic challenges. It aims to help pathologists develop hierarchically structured and logically consistent​ molecular diagnostic approaches, promoting the translation of integrated lymphoma diagnosis from theory into clinical practice.

Language="chi"><AbstractText>B细胞淋巴瘤的病理诊断正从传统形态学诊断迈向整合组织形态、免疫表型与基因改变的多维模式。构建规范化、阶梯化的临床病理诊断路径，是当前精准诊疗的迫切需求。本文系统梳理B细胞淋巴瘤的“四步法”整合诊断路径：第一步，初筛定型，依托免疫组织化学与流式细胞术完成谱系判定与初步分型；第二步，确诊鉴别，借助基因重排及原位杂交验证克隆性、明确特征性遗传学异常；第三步，精准诊疗，应用高通量测序进行分子分型、预后评估及靶向用药指导；第四步，前沿探索，利用单细胞与空间多组学技术、人工智能破解难题。旨在为病理医师构建系统化的分子诊断思路，推动淋巴瘤整合诊断从理论向临床实践迈进。.</AbstractText></OtherAbstract><CoiStatement>所有作者声明无利益冲突</CoiStatement></MedlineCitation><PubmedData><History><PubMedPubDate
